_comment: Budgets for scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs (kB). Initial = what index.html loads before the shell renders. Lazy chunks (editor, terminal, graph) and media are reported but deliberately not budgeted here. 185 -> 186 in 1.40: the settings store (two files, migration hooks, live settings.json reload) and the Mod+, shortcut; the registry and settings UI stay lazy. 186 -> 188 in 1.41: cluster names, colours and environment badges in the sidebar and context switcher at first paint (cluster metadata) and the window tint; the hub, guardrails, setup guide and provider marks stay lazy. 188 -> 191 in 1.42: the auth center core (credential state, recovery fan-out to watches/logs/port forwards, status refresh) and auth error classification, needed by every view at startup; the sign-in dialog, toasts, badges, notice, add-cluster dialog and vault prompts stay lazy. CSS 18 -> 18.5 in the design pass: Tailwind emits one stylesheet for every screen, lazy or not, and the calmer hub, settings, dialogs and setup guide use classes the old screens didn't (startup JS went down 1.9 kB in the same pass). CSS 18.5 -> 19.5 for the ecosystem and resource-depth screens (GitOps, usage charts, access review, Helm, operator views, panels): the same Tailwind effect; their JS stays lazy. JS 191 -> 192 for Helm depth: the routes and preload map of the new Charts page and its lazy chunks (+0.3 kB, main was at 190.9); every Helm screen stays lazy. JS 192 -> 193 for the API group navigation: the sidebar's loaders for the group mapping and operator icons and their preload map (+0.8 kB, main was at 191.3); the mapping, icons, CRD printer columns and operator tables and panels stay lazy. JS 193 -> 189 after the release batch: the side panel, message dialogs and workspace rename dialog load right after the first frame (main was at 191.8, now 187.6). JS 189 -> 155 (main was at 187.6, now 152.9): radix-vue ships as one 600 kB file and a module lives in exactly one chunk, so startup carried every primitive any lazy screen uses (combobox, select, tabs, number field, ...) plus @internationalized/date and /number. scripts/split-module.mjs splits that file into parts at build time, and every module index.html loads goes into one chunk instead of 25 (either alone saves 7.5 kB, together 33.5 kB: the split parts would otherwise be spread over ~30 small chunks). JS 155 -> 156 for split view and pop-out windows: the panes that follow the router (each with its own kept-alive cache, so the first pane keeps its state when a second opens), the Mod+\ shortcut and the window provider's API (+2.4 kB, main was at 152.9); pane headers, layout operations, palette commands, the window host and the whole pop-out window app stay lazy.
